purpose: Use the already-trusted WIF deployer in read-only mode to census project IAM bindings for existing owner/project-IAM/security-admin service accounts and test whether the deployer can impersonate any such service account to obtain resourcemanager.projects.setIamPolicy. Preserve human principals only as hashes. This is the final credential-free reuse search before treating the three remaining bindings as a genuine owner/admin authority gate.
truth_boundary: Read-only authority census only. Do not change IAM, create identities or keys, widen WIF trust, access secret payloads, run Gemini inference, build or deploy images, change Cloud Run traffic, send communications, publish, spend, or perform destructive actions. Any discovered admin service account is only a candidate until impersonation plus testIamPermissions returns provider-native setIamPolicy proof.
